Origin.description: One of Origin or Referer must be present and exactly match configured CORSOrigins on every unsafe method.
Origin.name: Origin

Referer.description: Alternative to Origin; one of Origin or Referer must be present and exactly match configured CORSOrigins on every unsafe method.
Referer.name: Referer

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or disabled learner session

Error403.description: CSRF Origin/Referer validation failed or a protected resource is not owned

Error413.description: Request body exceeds the login 4096-byte limit

Error429.description: Rate limit exhausted; no Retry-After header is emitted

DeckCardInput.description: Existing cardId or both frontText and backText are required by the Go handler.

primaryImageAssetId.description: Owned image asset to attach; omit to retain the current image.

removePrimaryImage.description: Remove the current image when primaryImageAssetId is omitted.

DeckInput.description: After titleVi aliasing, name must be non-empty.

visibility.description: Only public is retained; every other value becomes private.

DeckPatchInput.description: All fields optional. When cards is supplied, the server replaces the complete deck-card set.

token.description: Opaque raw session token; returned only at creation.

choices.description: KNOWN DEFECT: the Go field is []byte, so the stored JSON array [{"stepOrder":1,"choiceKey":"A"},...] is returned base64-encoded. Clients must base64-decode it, then parse the JSON. A server fix to json.RawMessage would change this to an array.

ScenarioAttemptResult.description: Server-computed score. maxPoints is the sum, over steps, of the highest points among optimal choices.

ScenarioChoice.description: Never carries the answer key: isOptimal, points and feedback come only from the answer endpoint.

choiceKey.description: Unique within its step; observed A, B, C. Choices are ordered by this key.

ScenarioChoiceRecord.description: Identify the choice either by stepId + choiceId (both required, UUIDs) or by stepOrder + choiceKey. Any 'points' sent by the client is ignored: the server scores from its own data.

ScenarioCompleteRequest.description: Exactly one record per step of the scenario; a wrong count, a duplicate step or an unknown choice is 400 and stores nothing.

attempts.description: Attempts by ALL learners, not only the caller.

ScenarioDetail.description: Only scenarios that are active, have at least one step and where every step has at least one choice are served; anything else is 404.

category.description: Free text column; observed values: email, phone, meeting.

difficulty.description: Free text column; observed values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

iconEmoji.description: An emoji character; do not use it as a navigation icon.

speakerName.description: Omitted when null. Observed value: a generic narrator label.

ScenarioStepAnswerRequest.description: Either field selects the choice; choiceKey wins when both are sent. The server matches the value against the step's choice_key OR choice id. An empty object is 400. Unknown fields are ignored (the handler does not reject them).

ScenarioStepAnswerResult.description: Feedback for one choice. Stateless: nothing is stored and the call may be repeated.

category.description: Free text column; observed values: email, phone, meeting.

difficulty.description: Free text column; observed values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

iconEmoji.description: An emoji character; do not use it as a navigation icon.
